extra.reason: Fixed; build green; verified linear speedup

Implemented B (lagged surface-tangent tailDir trails through medium) + D (discrete agitate with attack/release + whip transient on GO_THRESH) + E (planar->helical corkscrew under agitation). placeTail/updateTailState rewritten; new constants; userData extended; DESIGN.md updated; npm run build passes.

Completed and verified headless (30 sim-s no renderer: eating grows cells, slow range 0.02..1.0, mitosis to 121 cells, 210 foods queued to respawn). Transmission removed; sensing split (eat per-substep + throttled concentration); accumulator time-stepping; far-side culling.

Added this._v5 scratch vector so normal/normal2 in advance() are distinct and the two deflectHeading calls in solveCollisions() no longer share _v6. Verified: npm run build passes; headless slow 0.01..1.0 and mitosis intact.

Extracted foodDist(d,food,halfLen) shared by eatAndRespawn and concentration, removing the duplicated capsule->food clamp/distance block; writes delta to this._fd scratch. Verified npm run build + headless (cells grow, slow responds).

Extracted forEachNearbyFood(cx,cy,cz,r,cb) used by eatAndRespawn (r=1) and concentration (r=2); early return on cb()===false preserves the ABSORB_CAP break-scan semantics. Verified build + headless (slow 0.01..1.0, cells grow).
Extracted clearTail(cell) and used it in placeTail's sideHidden branch and removeCell, removing duplicated tail-matrix zeroing. Build passes.

Split setCellAppearance into updateGeometry(cell,length) (radius/mass/body geometry/nucleus scale) and updateColor(cell,length) (HSL + materials); setCellAppearance now calls both. No behavior change; build passes.

Reduce geometry churn in growth: updateGeometry rebuilds the body CapsuleGeometry only when the length crosses a GEO_STEP bucket (0.01) instead of every growCell; radius/mass/nucleus still use the exact length. Per-cell ownership (no cross-cell sharing) avoids shared-disposal hazards. Build + headless verified (cells grow).
Extracted food domain to src/food.js (grid, eating+sensing, clumps, makeFood/placeFood) as functions taking sim. Verified: build + headless (cells grow, slow responds, reset works).
Extracted cell domain to src/cells.js (makeBodyGeo/createCell/makeCell/growCell/mitose/placeTail/updateTailState/updateMito/clearTail/setTailColor/disposeObject3D). Verified build + headless.

Reduced sim.js to orchestrator (constructor/attach/buildWorld/reset/processSplits/removeCell/collision/advance/render lifecycle) importing from cells.js/food.js. Verified build + headless; bundle shrank via tree-shaking.
